summary: This stylesheet styles a comment or feedback card interface with two main sections: a type selection popup and a form for submitting feedback. It includes styling for buttons, text inputs, status messages, and adapts the appearance for dark mode by increasing shadow contrast and adjusting background colors.

explanations.2: Position absolute removes this element from normal document flow so it can be placed precisely, typically used for popups or overlays.
explanations.3: z-index 9999 stacks this element on top of nearly everything else on the page, ensuring the card appears above other content.
explanations.11: var(--ifm-background-surface-color) is a CSS variable that holds the theme's background color; using variables makes it easy to swap themes.
explanations.31: grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr creates two equal-width columns; 1fr means each column takes one equal portion of available space.
explanations.36: grid-column: 1 / -1 makes an element span from the first column to the last, taking up the full width of the grid.
explanations.51: The transition property animates changes to background and border-color over 0.12 seconds, creating a smooth hover effect.
explanations.65: line-height: 1 removes extra vertical space around the icon, keeping it compact with no padding above or below.
explanations.103: overflow-wrap: break-word allows long words to break mid-word rather than overflow the container.
explanations.120: margin-left: auto pushes this button to the right side of its container by consuming all available space on its left.
explanations.138: resize: vertical lets users manually drag the bottom edge to make the textarea taller, but not wider.
explanations.146: box-sizing: border-box ensures padding is included in the element's total width, preventing unexpected layout shifts.
explanations.156: left: -9999px moves the element far off-screen; this is a honeypot field used to catch spam bots that auto-fill form fields.
explanations.164: justify-content: flex-end aligns the buttons inside to the right side of their container.
explanations.265: The rgb() function with a variable creates a semi-transparent color by adding /0.15 for 15% opacity, useful for layering in dark mode.
